caseName: Lotus Development Corp. v. Borland International, Inc.
caseNameFull: LOTUS DEVELOPMENT CORP. v. BORLAND INTERNATIONAL, INC.
attorneys: Henry B. Gutman argued the cause for petitioner. With him on the briefs were Kerry L. Konrad, Jeffrey E. Ostrow, Arthur R. Miller, Neal D. Goldman, and Donald J. Rosenberg., Gary L.
